sets.relationshipLabel: A general category of plaything and a specific kind within it
sets.explanation: A yo-yo is a kind of toy, just as tag is a kind of game — each pair names a broad category and one clear example inside it.

sets.relationshipLabel: One who acts and the child their work is directed toward
sets.explanation: A teacher works for a student and a babysitter works for a child — both pairs link an adult role to the young person they serve.

sets.relationshipLabel: An earlier moment of childhood facing a later one across the same span
sets.explanation: Birth precedes graduation and toddler precedes teenager — each pair marks an earlier and later point on the same stretch of growing up.

sets.relationshipLabel: A young creature and the possession characteristic of it
sets.explanation: An infant is known for its rattle and a kid for a bicycle — each pair ties a stage of childhood to the object most associated with it.
